item.title: Flickbar 1.2.0
item.description:
### Added
- **简体中文 and 繁體中文.** Flickbar now speaks Simplified and Traditional Chinese. It follows your Mac's language, or choose one in *Settings → General → Language*. - **Gestures that press keys.** Set a title-bar gesture to **Send Keys…** in **Settings → Gestures** and record a key combination, such as ⌘C or ⌘V. The gesture brings its window to the front and presses those keys in it. - **Español.** Flickbar now speaks Spanish, and the French has been reviewed.
